detail.longDescription: Okta Shares Surge on Strong Earnings, Growing Demand for AI Identity Security 🚀 Okta stock surged 19% after crushing Q2 earnings! Revenue hit $805M (+11% YoY), subscription revenue up 12% to $793M. GAAP net income jumped to $116M with $4.86B subscription backlog. The identity security leader is doubling down on AI security, acquiring Permiso Security for better threat detection. FY2027 revenue guidance raised to $3.2-3.2B. AI agents need identity security—Okta's positioning to lead! 📈 https://www. securityweek.com/okta-shares-s urge-on-strong-earnings-growing-demand-for-ai-identity-security/ # AI # MachineLearning
